title: Coral and the Songbook
author: Zephyrine Voss
blurb: Quentin Underhill, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the festival ends.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
